_note: Talent roster v0.1. 'verse' is what the prime vestige says when asked what power it holds - cryptic on purpose, all original wording. 'hidden' are technicality flags rolled per save and discovered through play. 'canon': true marks talents that exist in the source books; everything else is original to this project.

talents.name: 1% Lifesteal
talents.verse: Wound the living a hundredfold, and one fold returns to you.
talents.rule: Gain heal points equal to 1% of damage dealt to anything alive. 1-star: Supreme quality only (100 pts/HP any layer).
talents.evolve_2: Dynamic quality: each wound layer healed at its native price.

talents.name: Borrowed Breath
talents.verse: When the last breath leaves, I lend you ten more. I collect.
talents.rule: On lethal damage, keep fighting for 10 s. Afterwards take the prevented damage as structural wounds.
hidden: kills in the window reduce the debt?
talents.evolve_2: Window 15 s; 30% of debt forgiven per kill.

talents.name: Scar Ledger
talents.verse: Every mended break is written down, and the page grows thicker.
talents.rule: Each structural wound fully healed adds +0.5% max HP to that body region, permanently.
talents.evolve_2: Catastrophic wounds add +3% and harden that region against the damage type that caused them.

talents.name: Hunger Engine
talents.verse: What you swallow of the beast, the beast forgives in you.
talents.rule: Eating monster flesh heals superficial damage and grants resistance to that monster's affinity for 10 min.
talents.evolve_2: Also borrow a weak copy of the eaten monster's talent for the duration.

talents.name: Tenth Strike
talents.verse: Nine knocks are courtesy. The tenth opens the door.
talents.rule: Every 10th hit on the same target deals x5 damage.
talents.evolve_2: Every 10th hit also ignores armour; the count survives switching targets once.

talents.name: Grudge
talents.verse: I remember each hand that touched you, and I weigh it.
talents.rule: +2% damage against a specific enemy for every hit that enemy has landed on you. No cap.
talents.evolve_2: Grudges transfer at half value to allies of the grudged enemy.

talents.name: Weight of Coin
talents.verse: Value is a kind of mass. Throw what you can afford to lose.
talents.rule: Thrown currency deals damage proportional to its face value. The money is destroyed.
talents.evolve_2: 20% of destroyed value is refunded on a kill.

talents.name: Glass Hour
talents.verse: The first grains fall fastest. After that, you are only sand.
talents.rule: For the first 6 s of any fight you deal x3 damage and take x3 damage.
hidden: applies to DoTs applied in the window?
talents.evolve_2: Each kill inside the window extends it by 1 s.

talents.name: Echo Hand
talents.verse: What you do, you do again, smaller, a moment late.
talents.rule: Every ability repeats once at 25% power after 1 s, from where you stood.
talents.evolve_2: Echo at 40%, cast from your current position.

talents.name: Stubborn Bone
talents.verse: Small insults I do not hear.
talents.rule: Structural damage below a threshold per hit is ignored entirely.
talents.evolve_2: Threshold doubles while below half HP.

talents.name: The Last Inch
talents.verse: You may have all of him but the end of him.
talents.rule: The final 10% of each wound layer takes 90% less damage.
hidden: applies per limb or whole body?
soul damage has a last inch?
talents.evolve_2: Final 20%.

talents.name: Debt of Pain
talents.verse: Not now. Later. And a little less.
talents.rule: Incoming damage is delayed 5 s, then arrives at 80%.
hidden: healing in the window pre-empts it?
killing the source cancels its pending damage?
talents.evolve_2: Delay 8 s; pending damage from a dead source is halved.

talents.name: Salt Skin
talents.verse: Nothing festers in salt. Nothing grows there either.
talents.rule: Immune to damage-over-time. Healing received from others is halved.
talents.evolve_2: Reflect 25% of prevented DoT back at its source.

talents.name: Doorframe
talents.verse: Every threshold you have crossed is one threshold.
talents.rule: Step between any two doorways you have touched in the current dungeon.
hidden: sealed entrance counts as a door?
talents.evolve_2: Carry one other person or one corpse through.

talents.name: Long Step
talents.verse: Six paces are yours. The seventh is mine, and I walk further.
talents.rule: Every 7th step covers 5 m instantly in the direction of travel.
talents.evolve_2: You choose which step is the long one, once per count.

talents.name: Unfalling
talents.verse: Down is an opinion.
talents.rule: No fall damage. Walk on walls for up to 3 s.
talents.evolve_2: Wall-time refreshes on a kill.

talents.name: Ledger Eyes
talents.verse: Everything alive keeps accounts. I can read them.
talents.rule: See exact HP, by layer, of anything alive.
hidden: shows a hint of latent aura?
talents.evolve_2: Also shows the target's next intended action half a second early.

talents.name: Yesterday Sight
talents.verse: I show you the room as it was. What it is, you must learn yourself.
talents.rule: Overlay of the room as it was 60 s ago: patrol paths, sprung traps, who was here.
talents.evolve_2: Choose any moment in the last 10 minutes.

talents.name: Price Sense
talents.verse: All things are worth something to someone. I know the someone.
talents.rule: See the true market value of any item, and who would pay it.
talents.evolve_2: See what an item will be worth in 30 days.

talents.name: Wrongness
talents.verse: When the pattern breaks, your teeth will ache.
talents.rule: Sense deviants nearby and hidden clauses on a dungeon's rule card.
hidden: triggers on your own hidden flags?
talents.evolve_2: Identify the deviant's talent category before engaging.

talents.name: Super Farmer
talents.verse: What you plant, prospers.
talents.rule: Crops you tend yield far more.
hidden: living scenery you plant counts as yours?
talents.evolve_2: Tended plants mature in a tenth of the time.

talents.name: Clean Cut
talents.verse: Nothing is wasted that passes under your knife.
talents.rule: Corpses you butcher yield double materials.
talents.evolve_2: Harvest materials from wounds on living targets.

talents.name: Packmule
talents.verse: Load is a number. I have changed the number.
talents.rule: Carry capacity x5; hauled weight never slows you.
talents.evolve_2: Carried corpses do not decay.

talents.name: Fine Print
talents.verse: There is always another clause. I will show it to you.
talents.rule: Hidden clauses in contracts, auction terms and rule cards are visible to you.
hidden: shows clauses the other party doesn't know about?
works on your own vestige's verse?
talents.evolve_2: Once per contract, strike one clause before signing; the other party may not notice.

talents.name: Mender
talents.verse: Broken is a direction. I know the way back.
talents.rule: Spend essence to restore gear durability.
talents.evolve_2: Mend other people's wounds at first-aid grade.

talents.name: Loyal Dead
talents.verse: The last to fall rises first, and rises yours.
talents.rule: The last thing you killed fights for you for 30 s at half strength.
hidden: its kills count as your kills?
talents.evolve_2: Duration lasts until it dies or you kill something else.

talents.name: Swarm Keeper
talents.verse: The small ones were always listening. Now they answer.
talents.rule: Vermin and insects in the environment obey simple commands.
hidden: their deaths matter to other talents?
talents.evolve_2: See through any one of them.

talents.name: Borrowed Hands
talents.verse: Two more hands, and neither of them yours.
talents.rule: A pair of spectral hands holds and uses one extra item.
hidden: do they count as limbs for limb-cost abilities?
talents.evolve_2: Four hands.

talents.name: Thick Soul
talents.verse: There, where others are paper, you are hide.
talents.rule: Your Netherecho projection has ten times the durability.
hidden: resists soul damage in reality too?
talents.evolve_2: Projection regenerates while stationary.

talents.name: Concept Tongue
talents.verse: Each of them is one word. I can pronounce it.
talents.rule: See a construct's concept and tier before it notices you. Binding is more likely to succeed.
hidden: naming a concept aloud provokes it?
talents.evolve_2: Preview the named upgrade a construct would give an ability.

talents.name: Anchor
talents.verse: You need not lie down to leave.
talents.rule: Project into the Netherecho while your body keeps walking on simple orders.
talents.evolve_2: Body defends itself with your most-used ability.

talents.name: Rat Tail
talents.verse: A tail. Like a rat has.
talents.rule: You grow a prehensile tail. Holds one light item; improves balance.
hidden: counts as a limb for limb-cost abilities?
talents.evolve_2: Tail is strong enough to hang from and strike with.

talents.name: Furnace Gut
talents.verse: Your waste heat is mine. I will find a use for it.
talents.rule: Reflux never locks an affinity. At 100 it vents as a damaging burst around you and drops to 50, wounding you.
hidden: vent counts as your damage for other talents?
talents.evolve_2: Vent on command at 60+.

talents.name: Slow Blood
talents.verse: What hurries in others, strolls in you.
talents.rule: Damage-over-time on you ticks at quarter speed for the same total.
talents.evolve_2: The total is also reduced by a third.

talents.name: Twin Clock
talents.verse: You rest twice in the time of once.
talents.rule: Sleep need halved. Meditation purges reflux twice as fast.
talents.evolve_2: Meditate while walking slowly.

talents.name: Spare Parts
talents.verse: What is cut from you is slow to understand it has left.
talents.rule: Your severed limbs obey you for 60 s: crawl, grab, hold a door.
hidden: limb can be reattached inside the window?
talents.evolve_2: Severed limbs last until you regrow the replacement.

talents.name: Heavy Name
talents.verse: They will feel you arrive before they see you.
talents.rule: Your aura presses as if you were one star higher. Does nothing else.
talents.evolve_2: Weak-willed enemies a star below you may flee on sight.

talents.name: Lucky Floor
talents.verse: The first snare is always asleep.
talents.rule: The first trap you trigger fails.
hidden: first per room, per dungeon, or per day?
talents.evolve_2: You learn how the failed trap works.

talents.name: Coupon
talents.verse: Sometimes the price is waived. Do not ask why.
talents.rule: 10% chance a consumable is not used up.
talents.evolve_2: 20%, and you know in advance when the next free one is.

talents.name: Clean Channel
talents.verse: What flows to you freely leaves no stain.
talents.rule: Essence supplied by your satellite generates no reflux.
hidden: tank essence spent alongside it is also clean?
talents.evolve_2: Satellite throughput +1 unit/s.
